cohort: 135 women treated with antenatal magnesium sulfate at less than 32 weeks of gestation
finding: While umbilical cord serum magnesium levels initially differed significantly among maternal BMI groups, after adjusting for confounders, neither maternal BMI nor plurality were significantly associated with maternal or umbilical cord serum magnesium levels after antenatal magnesium sulfate treatment.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was not associated with umbilical cord magnesium levels after adjusting for confounding variables.
